policy: Deterministic source conventions can block with a useful manual remedy and reasoned exact local exceptions. ERROR is not a claim of universal runtime defect or behavioral equivalence. Ambiguous transformations retain WARNING. No promoted rule autofixes.

method: Verify all 11 existing private local pins. Derive SQL/IaC panels once from the seven already captured unique local roots; do not fetch or modify consumers. Use the required isolated-corpus runner, fresh process per root and 250-file batch, three alternating baseline/candidate pairs. Baseline checkout is source/lock-equivalent to the base merge and each worker asserts its imported source belongs to the distinct selected root. Selected panels compare previously shipped WARNING implementations with candidate tiers; normal panels exercise all native rules including existing controls. No cache flushing or speedup claim. Only aggregate counts and authored-source fingerprints are public. Python normal panel retains the previously declared error-promotion-30-normal-v1 SHA-256 selection: at most 20 files per frozen Python root (128 files total), exercising all 146 native rules. SQL/IaC normal panels use their full respective selections. An unnecessarily broader Python normal attempt was stopped before any complete comparison and excluded; the original 128-file selection and 25% budget were retained. TypeScript corpus scans intentionally set allowInlineConfig=false: counts are selected AST findings ignoring inline ESLint configuration, not a consumer CI/debt census. Exact explained suppression behavior is verified separately by fixtures. Native Python/SQL/IaC scans retain their normal source suppression handling.
limitations: The 15 holds concern current predicates; stronger future tiers may be possible with separate evidence.

Strict-policy matches do not establish external API intent, wire ownership, workload requirements or resource criticality. These remain unclassified unless independently proven; use manual review and exact exceptions.
No live match for a bounded tier is not evidence of precision; labeled canonical positives and counterexamples establish that the tier can fire and abstain.
Pre-existing held WARNING rules retain documented ambiguity; do not claim zero false positives across all advisory rules.
Normal corpus timing and CI outcomes must pass before merge; no performance budget is relaxed.
